description: The reference answers for Fuaran.Compute.Elementary over AUTHORED hard inputs (Phase 593; their own file since Phase 630, every vector unchanged): the pinned elementary functions `exp`, `ln`, `log10` and the float-exponent `pow` over `x` (and `y`) at the reduction boundaries, both edges of the computed range, subnormal results and inputs, the near-one band of `ln`, the exact shortcuts of `pow` and every row of D43's special-value table. A float is its IEEE-754 binary64 bit pattern as sixteen lowercase hex digits, or `nan` for any NaN (whose pattern is the host's own canonical NaN and is not compared). `op` names the function; each vector answers `{ verdict: ok, value, table }` where `table` is what D43's special-value table said of the input first (`nan`, `value`, `undefined`, `compute`) and `value` the function's bits (`nan` where the table said `nan` or `undefined`), compared byte for byte; a vector the routine computed also carries `reference`, the correctly rounded bits of the true value, and `ulps`, the package's distance from it in units in the last place, which is at most one on every such vector (DECISIONS.md D52) and is itself part of the document a host must reproduce.
generator: Phase 621 (DECISIONS.md D76): the vectors whose `op` is `rng` hold the pinned SplitMix64 generator `Rng`. `seed` is a signed 64-bit integer in decimal and `stream` a stream index; each answers `{ verdict: ok, draws, uniform53, below1000, distinct }` over ONE stream `Rng.ofSeed seed stream` read in this order: `draws`, its first twenty 64-bit draws, each sixteen lowercase hex digits; `uniform53`, the next four draws as floats in [0, 1), each its binary64 bit pattern; `below1000`, the next four answers of `Rng.below 1000`; and `distinct`, how many of a FRESH stream's first two thousand draws are distinct, which is two thousand on a host whose 64-bit product is exact.
special: Phase 631 (DECISIONS.md D78): the vectors whose `op` is `gammaLn`, `gamma`, `betaLn`, `beta`, `regularizedGammaP`, `regularizedGammaQ`, `regularizedBeta`, `inverseRegularizedBeta`, `polygamma`, `digamma` or `trigamma` hold the pinned special functions of `Special`, over authored hard inputs: each function's zeros, poles and bounds, the boundaries between its arms, tiny and huge arguments, the reflections and every row of its special-value table. `input` names the operands in the function's argument order (`x`; `a`, `b`; `a`, `x`; `a`, `b`, `x`; `a`, `b`, `p`; `n`, `x`). Each answers `{ verdict: ok, value }`, the function's bits, compared byte for byte. A vector the routine computed to a finite, non-zero answer also carries `reference`, the true value rounded once to the nearest double (mpmath at fifty digits; for the inverse, the root nearest the answer), and `ulps`, the package's distance from it in units in the last place, which is itself part of the document a host must reproduce.
